title: Temporary restriction: no direct SQLite clients on live stores until lock-loss fix is verified
summary: No thread replies were returned. The linked P0 task is done: root cause was uploads GC opening/closing SQLite files in a backend worker thread, releasing process POSIX locks; the fix moves GC scanning to a child process and adds an integration regression test. Commits b79b2c1 and fdbe6f1 are ancestors of current local main. The task explicitly says activation requires the live backend to restart onto b79b2c1; the evidence note says that restart remained the owner's call. Therefore the repository fix is implemented, guarded, and integrated locally, but live activation/recovery is unverified and the original live-store restriction should not be considered lifted based on this audit.
nextAction: Buddis Development Lead / Product Development Lead: confirm the live backend has restarted on a build containing b79b2c1 and that normal API operation is healthy before lifting the direct-SQLite restriction; retain the separate in-progress detach-and-adopt task as active work.
